component.name: AV Relay
component.summary: Use your MacBook's camera and microphone on this computer

description.p: AV Relay makes a MacBook's camera and microphone show up on Ubuntu as a regular webcam ("MacBook Camera") and microphone ("MacBook Microphone") for any app, over the local network. The Mac's camera and microphone run only while an app here uses them.
Pair once with a 6-digit code shown on the Mac; the connection is encrypted end to end.
